title: Crash tech moved from Wright Patterson to private hands

tellings.quote: Let's just speculate for a second and say a UFO crashed over here and it was brought to Wright Patterson.

plain: Scott Ramsay, a researcher, speculates on podcast host Jesse Michels' show about what might happen after an unknown craft crashes. He asks listeners to imagine a crashed craft being taken to Wright Patterson, an Air Force base in Ohio, and suggests the technology could then be passed on to private companies. If true, it would mean the secrets of such craft sit outside government hands.
